subject: Expansion request: onboarding 3 additional squads + renewal amendment

Cc: Lattice Health Contracts <contracts@latticehealth.com>

Subject: Expansion: onboarding 3 additional squads & renewal terms

Hi Karthik,

Following up from our technical sync — Lattice is ready to move forward with adding three additional squads (two customer-facing apps + one analytics project) under our existing tenant. We need:

- 3 new API key namespaces (one per app)
- Staggered rollout over the next 6 weeks (canary to prod)
- A short-term amendment to include the additional committed capacity and a pricing note for the extra token usage

Procurement asked for an estimate of the cost delta and the timeline so they can align the internal approvals with our Nov renewal. Also flagged: security will need SOC2 artifacts and an allowlist/IP restriction option.

Attaching a brief overview of the proposed scope (Lattice-Rollout-Overview.pdf). Can you share a recommended MAP and a timeline? Also loop in whoever owns amendments on your side.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Director, Platform Integrations
Lattice Health

Marta — thanks for the clear scope. Happy to run this as a short addendum to your upcoming renewal. High-level proposal / next steps:

1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — I attached a working MAP (MAP-Lattice-v1.xlsx).
   - Week 0: Legal review & sign amendment
   - Week 1: Provision 3 API namespaces + test keys
   - Week 2: Canary flows for App A (customer-facing)
   - Week 3-4: App B and analytics rollout, monitoring cadence

2) Capacity & pricing — proposed approach: add a 12-month amendment that increases committed tokens for the tenant by 20% to cover the three squads. Discounted overcommit rate for token usage above baseline (details in MAP). I’ll have Ben run numbers and provide a line-item delta.

3) Security — we can provide SOC2 artifacts and a temporary allowlist. Laura, can your team prepare the SOC2 package and IP allowlist steps?

4) Keys & gating — we recommend staging keys first, then staged promotion. We can stagger issuance by app to match your internal release windows.

If this aligns, I’ll ask Legal to draft a one-page amendment for signature (DocuSign) and Ben will send the cost delta. Goal: get the amendment signed prior to the renewal so the teams are provisioned during your first week post-renewal.

Attachments: SOW-Lattice-draft.docx (first pass). Ben — please attach the line-item cost delta & the amended pricing table.
